blurb:

He wants to be an only dog. He's not reactive on walks and he's completely unbothered by the two large dogs that live upstairs in his foster home, so it's not a fear thing. He just does better as the one and only in the house. He showed some nervousness around younger kids too, so teens or adults would be the right match. If that sounds like your situation, Meeko is worth a serious look. Eleven years old doesn't mean slowing down. It means he already knows exactly who he is.

Mostly Mutts is in Kennesaw. Reach out through their website or give them a call to meet him.

blurb:

If that sounds like your house, Yasmeen is worth a visit.

blurb:
Cecelia was adopted once already, came back after nine months, and showed up to the shelter completely shut down. Scared. Different from the dog they'd known before. That tells you the return hit her hard. The good news is she's in a foster home now and doing great. Whole-body wags when she sees the volunteers she trusts. That's who she actually is underneath all the caution.

She's three years old, about 37 pounds, a Terrier/Boxer mix, and she's currently working through the Mostly Mutts University training program. She's already got sit, stay, come, and leave it locked in. Her foster family, who knows her better than anyone right now, says she's the perfect housemate. Her previous owners called her high energy. Her foster calls her easy. That's a big gap, and it probably says more about the environment than about Cecelia.

She does need patience upfront. New people, especially men, made her nervous, and she'll warn you with a snap if she feels cornered or grabbed at suddenly. The fix is simple: let her come to you. Don't rush it. Once she decides you're her person, she will literally try to sit in your lap. She'd do best as an only dog and with teens or adults in the home. If you've got a calm, patient setup and room for a dog who just needs to learn she's safe, Cecelia is going to surprise you.

Mostly Mutts is in Kennesaw. Visit their website to start an inquiry or call to set up a meet.
